ambient: A number is said. It was you.
The addition passes over you and continues downward.
The column is ruled again, one line further on.
description: You're a figure in a column, and the column is being added up by something that won't check its work twice. There's a number above you and a number below you and you're between them, and there's nothing else to you. The total is going to be correct.
name: The Sum

looks: It goes up out of sight and down out of sight and you're one line of it.
The figures either side of you were probably also people.
objects.name: the column

looks: It says a number, and the number is you, and then it says the next one.
It has done this column before and it'll do it again afterwards.
objects.name: the one adding

weather: There's no weather in a column of figures, and there never has been.
